about_the_game:
Voyage Router is a "navigation-based roguelike" where you explore procedurally generated terrain guided by your map.

Adapt your route as the environment and conditions change, and visit as many target points as possible.

In a future where humanity has expanded across the stars, the nomadic Ama people live aboard a roaming fleet, harvesting Aether Pearls from creatures called XIA, which appear in Dimensional Straits—zones formed within a dimensional interstice.

Together with your android partner, Tycho, board the Dimensional Diving Suit Heavy Gear and set out to explore countless Dimensional Straits.

Navigate the Procedurally Generated Terrain

Each Dimensional Strait is procedurally generated.

Study your map, plot your route, and try to visit as many targets as possible where the powerful Nushi-XIA await.

Face Enemies That Grow Stronger

As turns pass, the environment shifts and the XIA grow stronger.

Defeat the Nushi-XIA at each target point to strengthen your Heavy Gear and acquire new skills to turn the tide.

Adapt to Changing Conditions

Dimensional Straits are dotted with useful spots such as Dive Points for resupply and Dimensional Whirlpools that enable fast travel.

Stay alert to changes in the environment and your condition, and reroute your path accordingly to maximize your success.

Strengthen Your Gear Through Exploration

Aether Pearls collected during your missions can be exchanged for funds once brought back to your ship.

Use these resources to strengthen your Heavy Gear and push even further into the unknown.
